results.text: Further analyses of the hypertension detection and follow-up program. The Hypertension Detection and Follow-up Program was a randomised trial to compare all-cause mortality of patients receiving antihypertensive therapy in special clinics with those referred to the usual sources of care. All-cause mortality was significantly reduced overall, and in the mildest hypertensives, by stepped care.
